sentences.text_target: Last Tuesday, my alarm clock started to sound very early.
sentences.phonetic: /lɑːst ˈtjuːzdeɪ maɪ əˈlɑːm klɒk ˈstɑːtɪd tuː saʊnd ˈvɛri ˈɜːli/
sentences.text_native: Mardi dernier, mon réveil a commencé à sonner très tôt.

sentences.text_target: I tried to stop it with my hand.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ ˈtraɪd tuː stɒp ɪt wɪð maɪ hænd/
sentences.text_native: J'ai essayé de l'arrêter avec ma main.

sentences.text_target: My eyes were heavy and I felt very tired.
sentences.phonetic: /maɪ aɪz wɜː ˈhɛvi ænd aɪ fɛlt ˈvɛri ˈtaɪəd/
sentences.text_native: Mes yeux étaient lourds et je me sentais très fatigué.

sentences.text_target: I stayed under the warm blanket for a few minutes.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ steɪd ˈʌndə ðə wɔːm ˈblæŋkɪt fɔːr ə fjuː ˈmɪnɪts/
sentences.text_native: Je suis resté sous la couverture chaude pendant quelques minutes.

sentences.text_target: When I got up, the room felt very cold.
sentences.phonetic: /wɛn aɪ gɒt ʌp ðə ruːm fɛlt ˈvɛri kəʊld/
sentences.text_native: Quand je me suis levé, la pièce semblait très froide.

sentences.text_target: My feet touched the cold floor.
sentences.phonetic: /maɪ fiːt tʌtʃt ðə kəʊld flɔː/
sentences.text_native: Mes pieds ont touché le sol froid.

sentences.text_target: I took slow steps toward the bathroom.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ tʊk sləʊ stɛps təˈwɔːd ðə ˈbɑːθruːm/
sentences.text_native: J'ai fait des pas lents vers la salle de bains.

sentences.text_target: I looked in the mirror above the sink.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ lʊkt ɪn ðə ˈmɪrə əˈbʌv ðə sɪŋk/
sentences.text_native: J'ai regardé dans le miroir au-dessus du lavabo.

sentences.text_target: My face looked very pale.
sentences.phonetic: /maɪ feɪs lʊkt ˈvɛri peɪl/
sentences.text_native: Mon visage avait l'air très pâle.

sentences.text_target: I had a bad cough and a running nose.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ hæd ə bæd kɒf ænd ə ˈrʌnɪŋ nəʊz/
sentences.text_native: J'avais une mauvaise toux et le nez qui coulait.

sentences.text_target: I grabbed a paper tissue from the small box.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ græbd ə ˈpeɪpə ˈtɪʃuː frɒm ðə smɔːl bɒks/
sentences.text_native: J'ai attrapé un mouchoir en papier dans la petite boîte.

sentences.text_target: I knew I caught a bad cold.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ njuː aɪ kɔːt ə bæd kəʊld/
sentences.text_native: Je savais que j'avais attrapé un mauvais rhume.

sentences.text_target: I walked slowly into the kitchen to find some relief.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ wɔːkt ˈsləʊli ˈɪntuː ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn tuː faɪnd sʌm rɪˈliːf/
sentences.text_native: J'ai marché lentement vers la cuisine pour trouver un peu de soulagement.

sentences.text_target: I placed the kettle on the stove to boil water.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ pleɪst ðə ˈkɛtl ɒn ðə stəʊv tuː bɔɪl ˈwɔːtə/
sentences.text_native: J'ai posé la bouilloire sur la cuisinière pour faire bouillir de l'eau.

sentences.text_target: While waiting, I took a clean glass and a ceramic cup.
sentences.phonetic: /waɪl ˈweɪtɪŋ aɪ tʊk ə kliːn glɑːs ænd ə sɪˈræmɪk kʌp/
sentences.text_native: En attendant, j'ai pris un verre propre et une tasse en céramique.

sentences.text_target: I opened the high cupboard to check the shelves.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ ˈəʊpənd ðə haɪ ˈkʌbəd tuː tʃɛk ðə ʃɛlvz/
sentences.text_native: J'ai ouvert le placard en hauteur pour vérifier les étagères.

sentences.text_target: I found a bottle of sweet honey.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ faʊnd ə ˈbɒtl ɒv swiːt ˈhʌni/
sentences.text_native: J'ai trouvé un flacon de miel doux.

sentences.text_target: I cut a fresh lemon with a sharp knife.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ kʌt ə frɛʃ ˈlɛmən wɪð ə ʃɑːp naɪf/
sentences.text_native: J'ai coupé un citron frais avec un couteau bien aiguisé.

sentences.text_target: I poured the hot water into the cup.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ pɔːd ðə hɒt ˈwɔːtə ˈɪntuː ðə kʌp/
sentences.text_native: J'ai versé l'eau chaude dans la tasse.

sentences.text_target: I mixed the lemon juice and honey with a small spoon.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ mɪkst ðə ˈlɛmən dʒuːs ænd ˈhʌni wɪð ə smɔːl spuːn/
sentences.text_native: J'ai mélangé le jus de citron et le miel avec une petite cuillère.

sentences.text_target: The warm drink felt very good in my sore throat.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə wɔːm drɪŋk fɛlt ˈvɛri gʊd ɪn maɪ sɔː θrəʊt/
sentences.text_native: La boisson chaude a fait beaucoup de bien à ma gorge irritée.

sentences.text_target: I carried my warm cup into the living room.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ ˈkærid maɪ wɔːm kʌp ˈɪntuː ðə ˈlɪvɪŋ ruːm/
sentences.text_native: J'ai porté ma tasse chaude dans le salon.

sentences.text_target: I lay down on the long sofa and used a soft pillow.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ leɪ daʊn ɒn ðə lɒŋ ˈsəʊfə ænd juːzd ə sɒft ˈpɪləʊ/
sentences.text_native: Je me suis allongé sur le long canapé et j'ai utilisé un oreiller moelleux.

sentences.text_target: Outside the window, the grey rain was falling steadily.
sentences.phonetic: /ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ðə ˈwɪndə ðə greɪ reɪn wɒz ˈfɔːlɪŋ ˈstɛdɪli/
sentences.text_native: Dehors, à travers la fenêtre, la pluie grise tombait régulièrement.

sentences.text_target: Many quiet hours passed slowly while I rested.
sentences.phonetic: /ˈmɛni ˈkwaɪət ˈaʊəz pɑːst ˈsləʊli waɪl aɪ ˈrɛstɪd/
sentences.text_native: De nombreuses heures calmes ont défilé lentement pendant que je me reposais.

sentences.text_target: My body felt weak, so I took some simple medicine.
sentences.phonetic: /maɪ ˈbɒdi fɛlt wiːk səʊ aɪ tʊk sʌm ˈsɪmpl ˈmɛdsɪn/
sentences.text_native: Mon corps se sentait faible, alors j'ai pris un médicament simple.

sentences.text_target: I did not look at my phone or think about my work.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ dɪd nɒt lʊk æt maɪ fəʊn ɔː θɪŋk əˈbaʊt maɪ wɜːk/
sentences.text_native: Je n'ai pas regardé mon téléphone et je n'ai pas pensé à mon travail.

sentences.text_target: By the evening, my high fever started to go down.
sentences.phonetic: /baɪ ði ˈiːvnɪŋ maɪ haɪ ˈfiːvə ˈstɑːtɪd tuː gəʊ daʊn/
sentences.text_native: Vers le soir, ma forte fièvre a commencé à baisser.

sentences.text_target: I drank another large glass of fresh water before sleeping.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ dræŋk əˈnʌðə lɑːdʒ glɑːs ɒv frɛʃ ˈwɔːtə bɪˈfɔːr ˈsliːpɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: J'ai bu un autre grand verre d'eau fraîche avant de dormir.

sentences.text_target: I hoped tomorrow would bring better health.
sentences.phonetic: /aɪ həʊpt təˈmɒrəʊ wʊd brɪŋ ˈbɛtə hɛlθ/
sentences.text_native: J'espérais que demain m'apporterait une meilleure santé.
